rationale.consistency: Perfectly adheres to Caddy module conventions, naming, and configuration parsing patterns.
rationale.edge_cases: Flawlessly handles malformed cookies, quoting preservation, and precise suffix extraction using semicolon indexing.
rationale.scope: Meets all requirements but includes a minor unrelated addition of the CookieFilter validator interface assertion.
rationale.readability: Extremely clean, logical structure with well-named variables and appropriate comments.
rationale.robustness: Safely handles unexpected types in the zap field and ignores unparseable header values without panicking.
rationale.maintainability: Action evaluation is cleanly separated from string manipulation, making future modifications trivial.
